words.meaning: 我看你
adj. 无处不在的，普遍存在的
example_sentences: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern society.
The ubiquitous presence of social media has changed how we communicate.
Coffee shops are ubiquitous in big cities.
words.notes: 同义词: omnipresent, pervasive, everywhere

memory_tips.word_root: ubique (拉丁语"到处") + -ous (形容词后缀) = 到处都有的
memory_tips.mnemonic: "you-BIG-wi-tous" → 你(you)太大(big)了，到处都能看到你
memory_tips.association: 想象 WiFi 信号无处不在，ubiquitous 就像无线网络覆盖整个城市
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象一个巨大的蜘蛛网覆盖整个地球，每个角落都有

words.meaning: n. 意外发现珍奇事物的运气；机缘巧合
example_sentences: Finding this book was pure serendipity.
Many scientific discoveries were made by serendipity.
Our meeting was a happy serendipity.
words.notes: 这是英语中最美的单词之一，常用于描述美好的意外相遇

memory_tips.word_root: 源自童话《三位锡兰王子》(Serendip是锡兰的古称，即今天的斯里兰卡)
memory_tips.mnemonic: "serene-dip-ity" → 在宁静(serene)中蘸(dip)一下，获得惊喜
memory_tips.association: 就像你随便翻开一本旧书，发现里面夹着一张100元钞票
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象在海滩散步时，无意中发现一颗美丽的珍珠

words.meaning: adj. 短暂的，转瞬即逝的
example_sentences: Fame is often ephemeral.
The ephemeral beauty of cherry blossoms reminds us of life's transience.
Social media posts feel ephemeral compared to printed books.
words.notes: 反义词: permanent, lasting, enduring, eternal

memory_tips.word_root: epi- (在...上) + hemer (一天，希腊语) + -al = 只存在一天的 → 短暂的
memory_tips.mnemonic: "一-费-摸-弱" → 一费力气去摸，结果太弱了，转瞬即逝
memory_tips.association: 蜉蝣(ephemera)只活一天，ephemeral 就是像蜉蝣一样短暂
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象清晨的露珠，太阳一出来就消失了

words.meaning: n. 杠杆作用；影响力 v. 充分利用（资源、优势）
example_sentences: We need to leverage our existing customer base to increase sales.
The company leveraged its brand recognition to enter new markets.
He used his connections to leverage a better deal.
words.notes: 商务场景中常用作动词，表示"充分利用"

memory_tips.word_root: lever (杠杆) + -age (名词后缀) = 杠杆作用 → 借力、利用
memory_tips.mnemonic: lever(杠杆) → 阿基米德说给我一个杠杆我能撬动地球 → 借力使力
memory_tips.association: 想象用一根杠杆撬动巨石，leverage 就是用小力量获得大效果
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象跷跷板，一点点力就能抬起重物

words.meaning: n. 协同作用；协同效应（1+1>2的效果）
example_sentences: The merger will create significant synergies between the two companies.
There's a great synergy between our marketing and sales teams.
We're looking for synergies to reduce costs.
words.notes: 常用于并购、团队合作等场景，强调合作产生的额外价值

memory_tips.word_root: syn- (共同，希腊语) + erg (工作，能量) + -y = 共同工作 → 协同
memory_tips.mnemonic: "syn-能-激" → 共同(syn)产生能量，激发更大效果
memory_tips.association: 想象两个齿轮配合转动，比单独转动更有效率
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象两只手合在一起鼓掌，比单手拍响亮得多

words.meaning: n. 利益相关者；利益攸关方
example_sentences: We need to consider all stakeholders before making this decision.
Key stakeholders include investors, employees, and customers.
The project manager held a meeting with all stakeholders.
words.notes: 包括股东、员工、客户、供应商等所有与公司/项目相关的人

memory_tips.word_root: stake (桩，赌注) + holder (持有者) = 持有赌注的人 → 利益相关者
memory_tips.mnemonic: stake(赌注) + holder(持有人) → 在这件事上下了注的人
memory_tips.association: 想象一场扑克游戏，所有下了赌注的人都是 stakeholder
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象一个圆桌，周围坐着投资人、员工、客户，他们都关心公司的发展

words.meaning: adj. 可扩展的；可规模化的
example_sentences: We need a scalable solution that can grow with our business.
This business model is highly scalable.
Is your software architecture scalable to handle millions of users?
words.notes: 常用于描述商业模式、技术架构能否随业务增长而扩展

memory_tips.word_root: scale (规模，刻度) + -able (能够) = 能够扩大规模的
memory_tips.mnemonic: scale(规模) + able(能够) → 能够放大规模
memory_tips.association: 想象一个气球，能够不断吹大而不会爆炸
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象乐高积木，可以无限拼接扩展

words.meaning: n. 带宽；（比喻）精力、时间、能力
example_sentences: I don't have the bandwidth to take on another project right now.
Do you have bandwidth to help with this task?
The team's bandwidth is limited this quarter.
words.notes: 原义是网络带宽，商务中常比喻为人的时间/精力/处理能力

memory_tips.word_root: band (带) + width (宽度) = 带宽 → 引申为处理能力
memory_tips.mnemonic: 网络带宽越大，能传输的数据越多；人的 bandwidth 越大，能处理的事越多
memory_tips.association: 想象一条高速公路，车道越多(带宽越大)，能通过的车越多
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象一个水管，口径越大，水流越大

words.meaning: n./v. 转型；（战略）转向；支点
example_sentences: The startup decided to pivot from B2C to B2B.
We need to pivot our strategy in response to market changes.
Instagram pivoted from a check-in app to a photo-sharing platform.
words.notes: 在创业圈特别常用，指公司调整商业模式或战略方向

memory_tips.word_root: pivot 原义是"枢轴、支点"，像篮球中的轴心脚转身
memory_tips.mnemonic: 想象篮球运动员一只脚固定，另一只脚转动找角度 → 战略转型
memory_tips.association: 想象一个旋转门，围绕中心点转动方向
memory_tips.image_hint: 想象指南针的指针，可以灵活转向

words.meaning: adj. 过时的；废弃的
example_sentences: The review found some features obsolete and highlighted areas for improvement.
Floppy disks are now obsolete technology.
words.notes: 常指因出现更新、更好的替代品而变得过时

words.meaning: n. 改进空间；待改进之处
example_sentences: The review found some features obsolete and highlighted areas for improvement.
We identified several areas for improvement in our customer service.
words.notes: 绩效评估或复盘时的常用委婉语，指缺点或不足

words.word: The review found some features obsolete and highlighted areas for improvement.
words.meaning: 这次评估发现了部分的功能过时，并指出了改进空间。
words.notes: 一句话搞定两个单词: obsolete, areas for improvement

words.meaning: n. 根本原因；基本原理；理论基础
example_sentences: The rationale behind the change is to serve the goal of better performance.
He explained the rationale for his decision.
words.notes: 指决策或行动背后的逻辑依据

words.meaning: v. 为实现目标；服务于目标
example_sentences: The rationale behind the change is to serve the goal of better performance.
All our efforts must serve the goal of customer satisfaction.
words.notes: 强调行动的目的性

words.word: The rationale behind the change is to serve the goal of better performance.
words.meaning: 这次改动的根本原因是为实现更好的性能目标。
words.notes: 一句话搞定两个单词: rationale, serve the goal

words.meaning: n. 分配；配置；安置
example_sentences: Effective allocation of resources enables better system optimization and faster performance.
Asset allocation is key to investment strategy.
words.notes: 常用于资源、资金、时间的分配

memory_tips.word_root: ad- (to) + locus (place) -> allocate (to place)

words.meaning: n. 优化；最佳化
example_sentences: Effective allocation of resources enables better system optimization and faster performance.
Search engine optimization (SEO) is important for websites.
words.notes: 使某事变得尽可能有效或完美的过程

memory_tips.word_root: optimus (best)

words.word: Effective allocation of resources enables better system optimization and faster performance.
words.meaning: 有效的资源配置能够实现更好的系统优化，并提升系统性能。
words.notes: 一句话搞定两个单词: allocation, optimization

words.meaning: v. 正在做；正在处理；致力于
example_sentences: I'm working on the report right now.
We're working on a solution to fix this issue.
She's been working on this project for three months.
words.notes: 表示正在进行某项工作，是职场最常用的表达之一

memory_tips.mnemonic: work(工作) + on(在...上) → 在某件事上工作 → 正在做
memory_tips.association: 想象一个人趴在桌子上专心工作的画面

words.meaning: v. 重新安排时间；延期；改期
example_sentences: Can we reschedule the meeting to next week?
I need to reschedule my flight due to the weather.
The event has been rescheduled for March 15th.
words.notes: 比 delay 或 postpone 更中性、更专业，暗示会重新安排具体时间

memory_tips.word_root: re- (再次) + schedule (安排) = 重新安排时间
memory_tips.mnemonic: re(再) + schedule(日程) → 重新排日程 → 改期
memory_tips.association: 想象日历上把一个事项擦掉，移到另一天

words.meaning: v. 澄清；阐明；使明确
example_sentences: Could you clarify what you mean by that?
Let me clarify the requirements before we proceed.
I'd like to clarify a few points from the last meeting.
words.notes: 非常礼貌的说法，用于请求对方解释或自己解释清楚某事

memory_tips.word_root: clar- (清楚，来自拉丁语 clarus) + -ify (使...) = 使清楚
memory_tips.mnemonic: clar(清晰，如 clear) + ify(使) → 使清晰 → 澄清
memory_tips.association: 想象混浊的水变清澈的过程

words.meaning: 按原计划进行；继续执行原定方案
example_sentences: After discussion, we decided to proceed with the original plan.
Let's proceed with the original plan unless there are objections.
The team agreed to proceed with the original plan despite the challenges.
words.notes: proceed 比 continue 更正式，常用于会议和邮件中表示执行决定

memory_tips.word_root: proceed (前进、继续) + with (伴随) + original plan (原计划)
memory_tips.mnemonic: pro(向前) + ceed(走) → 向前走，按原来的路线 → 按原计划进行
memory_tips.association: 想象GPS导航说「继续沿原路线行驶」

words.word: finish it by the end of this month
words.meaning: 在这个月底之前完成
example_sentences: I'll finish it by the end of this month.
Can you finish the report by the end of this month?
We need to finish the project by the end of this month to meet the deadline.
words.notes: by 表示「在...之前」，是设定截止日期的标准表达

memory_tips.mnemonic: by = 在...之前（deadline之前的意思）；end of this month = 月底
memory_tips.association: 想象日历上月底那一天画了一个红圈
similar_words: wrap up by the end of the month

words.meaning: v. 感谢；感激；欣赏；理解
example_sentences: I really appreciate your help with this project.
We appreciate you taking the time to meet with us.
I'd appreciate it if you could send me the report by Friday.
words.notes: 比 thank you 更正式，职场邮件和会议中非常常用。I appreciate it = 我很感激

memory_tips.word_root: ap- (to) + preci (价值，来自拉丁语 pretium) + -ate = 认识到价值 → 感激、欣赏
memory_tips.mnemonic: a-price(价格)-ate → 能看到价值的 → 感激/欣赏
memory_tips.association: 想象有人帮了你一个大忙，你从心底觉得这份帮助很有价值

words.meaning: 我们今天的会议日程/议程是
example_sentences: Our agenda today is to discuss the Q2 roadmap and assign tasks.
Our agenda today is fairly straightforward — just two items to cover.
Let me quickly go through our agenda today: first, project updates; second, budget review.
words.notes: agenda 是会议中最常用的词之一，指会议议程/日程安排。开会时用来引出讨论主题

memory_tips.word_root: agenda 来自拉丁语 agere (做)，原义是「要做的事情」
memory_tips.mnemonic: a-gen(基因)-da → 会议的基因/核心 → 议程
memory_tips.association: 想象会议室白板上列着今天要讨论的清单

words.meaning: v. 监控；监视；跟踪 n. 显示器；监视器
example_sentences: We need to monitor the server performance closely after deployment.
The team is monitoring the situation and will provide updates.
Please monitor the error logs for any anomalies.
words.notes: 在 IT/互联网行业非常高频，常用于描述对系统、数据、指标的持续观察和跟踪

memory_tips.word_root: monit- (警告，来自拉丁语 monere) + -or = 发出警告的人/物 → 监控器
memory_tips.mnemonic: monitor → 班长(monitor)负责监督班级 → 监控
memory_tips.association: 想象一个大屏幕上显示着各种系统指标和图表，运维人员盯着看

words.meaning: n. 配置；配置文件；构造
example_sentences: Please update the database configuration before deploying.
The system configuration needs to be reviewed for security issues.
Check the configuration file for any incorrect settings.
words.notes: IT行业核心词汇，常缩写为 config。配置文件通常叫 config file / configuration file

memory_tips.word_root: con- (一起) + figur (形状) + -ation = 把各部分组合成形 → 配置
memory_tips.mnemonic: config(配置) 是它的缩写形式，程序员天天打交道
memory_tips.association: 想象拼乐高积木，按照说明书把零件配置好

words.meaning: 清楚地记录/编制API更改文档
example_sentences: Please document the API changes clearly so that other teams can integrate smoothly.
It's important to document the API changes clearly before releasing a new version.
The tech lead asked us to document the API changes clearly in the changelog.
words.notes: document 作动词时意为「记录、编写文档」，在开发团队中非常常用。强调变更的可追溯性和团队协作

memory_tips.word_root: document (v.) = 记录、用文档形式记载；API changes = API变更；clearly = 清楚地
memory_tips.mnemonic: doc(文档) + u + ment → 把东西变成文档 → 编制文档
memory_tips.association: 想象程序员在 README 或 Changelog 里认真记录每一次 API 接口的变化

words.meaning: adj. 已废弃的；被标记为过时的；不推荐使用的
example_sentences: This method has been deprecated and will be removed in the next major version.
Please stop using the deprecated API and migrate to the new one.
The deprecated feature still works but is no longer maintained.
words.notes: IT 行业核心术语。deprecated 不等于已删除，而是「不推荐使用，未来可能移除」。常见于代码注释、文档、版本更新日志

memory_tips.word_root: de- (向下) + prec (祈祷) + -ate = 祈祷它消失 → 废弃
memory_tips.mnemonic: de(去掉) + prec(价值) + ated → 被去掉价值的 → 废弃的
memory_tips.association: 想象代码里一个函数上面画了一条删除线 ~~deprecated~~，提醒你别再用了

words.meaning: 让工作看起来没有收获/没有成就感
example_sentences: The constant changes in requirements made the work seem unrewarding.
Lack of recognition from management made the work seem unrewarding.
Spending weeks on a feature only to have it cancelled made the work seem unrewarding.
words.notes: unrewarding = un-(否定) + rewarding(有回报的)。这个短语常用于表达对工作缺乏成就感的感受，职场中很实用

memory_tips.word_root: un- (否定) + reward (回报) + -ing = 没有回报的；make...seem... = 让...看起来...
memory_tips.mnemonic: un(不) + reward(奖励) + ing → 没有奖励感的 → 没有收获的
memory_tips.association: 想象辛辛苦苦种了一块地，结果颗粒无收的感觉
